items.exampleEn: Advertising is a form of persuasion.
items.exampleZh: 廣告是一種說服的手段。

items.exampleEn: She is pessimistic about finding a job this year.
items.exampleZh: 她對今年找到工作很悲觀。

items.exampleEn: Every culture has its own worldview.
items.exampleZh: 每個文化都有自己的世界觀。

items.exampleEn: He is obsessive about keeping his desk tidy.
items.exampleZh: 他對保持書桌整齊非常執著。

items.exampleEn: The plan to close the library met with strong disapproval.
items.exampleZh: 關閉圖書館的計畫遭到強烈反對。

items.exampleEn: My phone has predictive text that guesses my next word.
items.exampleZh: 我的手機有預測輸入功能，會猜我下一個要打的字。

items.exampleEn: We tried every conceivable way to fix the old printer.
items.exampleZh: 我們試了所有想得到的方法來修那台舊印表機。

items.exampleEn: Some teachers disapprove of using phones in class.
items.exampleZh: 有些老師不贊成上課時用手機。

items.sentenceEn: Shops use predictive tools to guess what customers will buy.
items.sentenceZh: 商店會用預測工具來猜顧客會買什麼。

items.audioEn: My grandfather's worldview is very different from mine, but we still enjoy talking.
items.audioZh: 我爺爺的世界觀跟我很不一樣，但我們還是很喜歡聊天。
items.questionZh: 說話者和爺爺相處得怎麼樣？
options: They see the world the same way

items.sentenceEn: Don't be so pessimistic; the test might be easier than you think.
items.sentenceZh: 別那麼悲觀，考試可能比你想的簡單。

items.sentenceEn: Loud music after ten is something our neighbors strongly disapprove of.
items.sentenceZh: 晚上十點後放大聲音樂，是我們鄰居非常不贊成的事。

items.stemEn: It's ____ that the shop will close, but I hope it won't.
items.stemZh: 那家店有可能會關門，但我希望不會。

items.stemEn: He counts his steps all day and writes down every number; it's becoming ____.
items.stemZh: 他整天數自己走了幾步，還把每個數字都記下來，越來越像著了迷。

items.passageEn: Last spring, my brother decided he wanted to keep chickens in our small garden. My parents disapproved at first. Dad was pessimistic and said the birds would make too much noise, and Mom worried about a foul smell. My brother used every kind of persuasion he could think of. He made a chart showing how many eggs we could get, and he read about chickens in an almost obsessive way. In the end, it became conceivable to my parents that the plan might work. Now we have three chickens, and Dad's only sign of disapproval is a small sigh when they wake him up early.
items.passageZh: 去年春天，我的兄弟決定要在我們家的小院子裡養雞。爸媽一開始都不贊成。爸爸很悲觀，說雞會太吵；媽媽則擔心會有難聞的味道。我的兄弟用盡了他想得到的各種說服方法。他做了一張圖表，算出我們可以收到多少顆蛋，還近乎著迷地讀了很多養雞的資料。最後，爸媽開始覺得這個計畫可能行得通。現在我們養了三隻雞，爸爸唯一表示不滿的方式，就是被雞一大早吵醒時輕輕嘆一口氣。

questions.questionZh: 爸爸一開始為什麼不贊成？
作者的兄弟怎麼說服爸媽？
options: 做了一張可以收多少蛋的圖表

items.promptZh: 這本書改變了我的世界觀。
referenceEn: Reading this book changed my worldview.
This book has changed my worldview.
rubricZh: worldview 的用法，例如 changed my worldview、has changed my worldview 等
時態合理（例如 changed、has changed 等）

items.promptZh: 經過一番勸說，我弟弟終於答應洗碗。
referenceEn: After some persuasion, my brother finally agreed to wash the dishes.
With a little persuasion, my younger brother finally agreed to do the dishes.
rubricZh: persuasion 當名詞（例如 after some persuasion、with a little persuasion 等）
「洗碗」可寫，例如 wash the dishes、do the dishes 等；時態可用過去式或現在完成式（例如 agreed、has agreed 等）
